title: EVN Open practice · Level 3: A shifted start and a push
brief: Practice for the EVN Open capstone (G12.4): never a capstone level, which your teacher witnesses on your own option's task. The course fixes one example set of approved requirements. R1 (headline): the whole robot in the green goal. R2 (safety): never touch a wall or a block, and never enter the red crossing. R3: the goal within 20 s. R4: square as the whole robot first fits in the goal (the run ends there, so square up before it): heading within 10 deg of east. A run that breaks R2 scores 0 and fails the level, whatever else it did; any other run scores 25 for each requirement it meets. A requirement is met over the level when it holds on at least 80 % of the runs (R2 on every run). Level 3: ten runs from a shifted start (+-40 mm, +-6 deg), each with one push the course draws: at 2 to 8 s, 50 to 100 mNs, 100 mm ahead of the axle, to the left or the right: a kick that turns the robot (one holding still on its motors turns about 0.5, 1.5 or 3 deg). Pass: no run breaks R2, and R1, R3 and R4 each hold on at least 8 of the 10 runs; a run that stops safely after the push (no breach) misses R1 and is allowed. Par: 16 s.

score.run: if(touches > 0 | noGoEntries > 0, 0, 25 + if(reached, 25, 0) + if(reached & time <= tmax, 25, 0) + if(reached & abs(wrap180(endHeading)) <= square, 25, 0))

inTime.value: count(r in runs: r.reached & r.time <= tmax)

squareIn.value: count(r in runs: r.reached & abs(wrap180(r.endHeading)) <= square)

met.value: if(breaches == 0, 1, 0) + if(goal >= 0.8 * n, 1, 0) + if(inTime >= 0.8 * n, 1, 0) + if(squareIn >= 0.8 * n, 1, 0)

pass: breaches == 0 & goal >= 0.8 * n & inTime >= 0.8 * n & squareIn >= 0.8 * n

sources.where: G12.4 Capstone: EVN Open - the level table (60 % of the approved requirements, the headline among them; the Wilson 95 % lower bound at 60 % over n >= 20; every shall on 8 of 10 with a fault survived or safely stopped) and the safety gate (a breach scores 0 and fails the level)
